title: Crypto metadata retention and SSO verification PRD + signoff checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD for establishing a canonical crypto metadata retention policy and an SSO verification surface for Private/VPC deployments. This covers how we store and retain per-request key metadata, HSM/KMS connection artifacts, SSO assertion verification hooks, RBAC audit binding, and a reproducible signoff checklist that evidences compliance for enterprise customers.
background: Enterprise customers onboarding Private deployments require auditable evidence for key custody, KMS/HSM connection lifecycle, SSO assertion verification, and RBAC change history. Existing artifacts are fragmented across runbooks and operator notes. This PRD consolidates requirements, defines retention windows, schema for metadata, and acceptance tests for signoff.
goals: 1) Define a minimal canonical crypto metadata schema and retention policy that satisfies common audit requirements (e.g., 1 year baseline, 7-year for regulated customers). 2) Define automated SSO verification checks to assert SAML assertion binding, signature verification, and session replay protections. 3) Provide a checklist and evidence bundle format that engineering, security, and legal can sign off on during Private deployment onboarding.
success_metrics: 1) 100% of new Private onboarding requests accepted with a completed evidence bundle. 2) Reduction of security review cycle time from average 7 days to <=3 days. 3) Demonstrable audit queries for key metadata return within SLA (<=5s) in 95% of trials.
scope_in_scope: - Canonical metadata model (fields, types, retention tags) for keys, certificates, and HSM sessions. - Retention policies parametrized per-customer (default/regulated). - Automated checks for SSO/SAML assertion signature validation and audience/session binding. - Audit log canonicalization and query surface for evidence bundles. - Signoff checklist generation and storage for compliance review.
scope_out_of_scope: - Full re-architecture of the current audit pipeline. - Changes to hosted (non-private) API contracts. - Implementing new HSM vendor plugin drivers beyond compatibility testing with our existing HSM connector.
user_stories: As a security engineer, I need a canonical crypto metadata schema so I can explain key custody in audits.
As a platform operator, I need automated SSO assertion verification tests so deployments fail fast on misconfiguration.
As a customer compliance officer, I need an evidence bundle that includes signed manifests and log snapshots for onboarding signoff.
As a product manager, I need a clear acceptance checklist that cross-teams can use to reduce back-and-forth during audits.
requirements: REQ-001: Define metadata fields: key_id, key_type, origin(KMS/HSM), wrapping_key_id, creation_ts, last_used_ts, rotation_ts, operator_identity, retention_tier.
REQ-002: Retention tiers: default(1 year), extended(7 years), ephemeral(30 days). Configurable per-customer via onboarding manifest.
REQ-003: Audit log entries must include canonical metadata snapshot and a signed manifest (SHA256) stored in the evidence store.
REQ-004: SSO verification service must validate SAML signatures, audience restrictions, NotOnOrAfter, and include replay-detection using assertion IDs and a 5-minute TTL cache.
REQ-005: RBAC actions affecting key material (create, rotate, revoke) must emit structured audit events including actor, change delta, request_id, and pre/post metadata.
REQ-006: Evidence bundle format: JSON manifest + gzipped log window + signed certificate chain. Bundle must be exportable via Console and API.
REQ-007: Provide sample onboarding manifest templates and a validation tool (CLI) that runs pre-checks against customer KMS/HSM endpoints and SSO metadata endpoints.
REQ-008: Performance requirement: audit queries for evidence bundles must return within 5s for 95th percentile for a 90-day window.
REQ-009: Provide RBAC policy migration notes and a fallback safe-mode that disables privileged ephemeral ops if misconfigured.
REQ-010: Logging must redact secret material while preserving structural metadata required for audits.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Metadata schema is documented and published in the internal spec repo; all fields present in at least one storage table and indexable by key_id.
AC-2: Retention tiers are configurable per-customer; demo page in Console shows selected tier and enforced retention; a retention purge job demonstrates expiry behavior in a staging runbook.
AC-3: SSO verification test harness simulates invalid signatures, wrong audience, expired assertions, and replay; all error cases produce clear operator-facing errors and guidance.
AC-4: Evidence bundle can be created from a Console action and via API; bundle includes signed manifest and log window; signature verifies with stored signing key.
AC-5: Audit queries for sample evidence bundles in staging return within 5s at 95th percentile in load tests.
AC-6: Role-based change events for keys are emitted and visible in Console timeline with actor identity matching external SSO subject.
AC-7: Security review signoff obtained from Security Eng, Legal, and Compliance; checklist items individually checked and timestamped in the bundle manifest.

AC-8: Operator CLI validation tool is able to detect at least the top 5 common misconfigurations (wrong metadata URL, missing signing certificate, HSM unreachable, incorrect partitioning, TTL mis-set).
rollout_signoff_checklist: PM approves final spec and release notes.
Security engineering signs off on metadata schema and SSO verification approach.
Identity team approves SAML assertion validation changes.
Infra/Platform leads approve evidence store performance and purge jobs.
Legal confirms evidence bundle contents satisfy contractual requirements for target customers.
Support and Solutions Engineering sign off on CLI tool and onboarding templates.
QA completes full regression and L7 load tests and confirms results in shared dashboard.
Documentation updated: Console, API, Onboarding runbook, and Security FAQ.
One pilot customer successfully completes onboarding using the new evidence bundle and signs acceptance.
test_plan: Unit tests for metadata serialization/deserialization and retention tagging.
Integration tests: KMS/HSM connector simulated endpoints with rotation and failure injection.
SSO test harness: valid and invalid SAML flows, replay, expired assertion tests.
End-to-end: Create key, rotate, revoke in staging; generate evidence bundle and validate signature and contents.
Performance: Load test audit queries across 30, 90, 365-day windows to validate 95th percentile SLA.
Operator acceptance: Run CLI tool on a customer-provided staging environment and document findings.
risks: RISK-1: Overly verbose metadata may increase storage costs and slow queries — mitigation: index only required fields and tier retention.
RISK-2: Misconfigured SSO metadata endpoint at customer side will block onboarding — mitigation: provide a preflight validator and clear error guidance.
RISK-3: Evidence bundle contains PII inadvertently — mitigation: redact PII fields by default and list redaction rules in the manifest.
RISK-4: Long-term retention regulatory variance across regions — mitigation: allow per-region retention configuration and legal signoff.
notes: Implement signed manifests with rotating signing keys and publish key IDs in Console so auditors can verify bundles offline.
Consider CBOR or compact binary format for large bundles; keep JSON manifest for human readability.
Work with Solutions Eng to produce a 'one-click' export for customer auditors with time-bound snapshots.
Coordinate rollout with Private deploy upgrades to ensure evidence store schema migrations are non-breaking.
